name: OpenAI Responses API function tools

example.name: get_weather
example.description: Retrieves current weather for the given location.

fields.name: required
fields.parameters: required in the reference schema but nullable; JSON Schema object
fields.strict: required in reference schema but nullable; guide says omitting strict on Responses may fall back to non-strict
fields.output_schema: optional, nullable; JSON schema describing the JSON value encoded in string outputs

tool_result.error: No dedicated error flag documented; output is a string (typically JSON) or an array of text/image/file content - put the error text there.

schema_rules: Same strict-mode rules as Chat Completions (shared function-calling + structured-outputs guides): additionalProperties:false on every object, every property in required, optional via null union, root object without anyOf, same keyword subset and size limits.
Tools inside a namespace (tool search) have documented pattern ^(?![\s\S]*[\r\n])[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$, length 1-128; namespace pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$, length 1-64.

sources.what: flat tool shape, function_call and function_call_output examples, strict rules
Function tool fields, FunctionCall/FunctionCallOutput item fields, namespace name patterns

uncertain: Top-level Responses function 'name' has no pattern/length listed in the reference portion read (first 100k of 558k chars); assume the Chat Completions 64-char rule only as a safe lower bound - unconfirmed.
Whether strict defaults to true when omitted on Responses: guide only says omitting may fall back to non-strict.

check.why: 机器检查用：name 是导出后工具名要满足的正则（取各处文档里最严的那个），forbid_keys 是参数 schema 里不能出现的关键字；依据见 name_rule / schema_rules / sources
